sections.title: Stories
sections.description: Watch the story, learn the new words, then play and answer.

items.title: Oliver Twist
items.description: Follow Oliver's adventure chapter by chapter — watch each chapter video inside the site.

sections.title: Grammar
sections.description: Short, simple lessons with cards, video and lots of practice questions.

items.title: Quantifiers: Too & Enough
items.description: Easy cards, a short video and 95 practice questions — too & enough first, then too many, too much, all, no, none, most, a few and a little.

items.title: Pizza Chef: Quantifiers Game
items.description: Read the order, pick the right quantifier and build the pizza! 4 levels, 3 lives and stars to collect.

sections.title: Games
sections.description: Browser games for warm-ups, icebreakers, and first-day fun.

items.title: Oliver Twist Adventure
items.description: A Victorian adventure map for Chapters 10 & 11 — 12 stages, 12 different mini-games, a storybook to collect and a certificate at the end.

items.title: Oliver Twist: Into the Thieves' Den
items.description: A Victorian adventure map for Chapters 7, 8 & 9 — 12 stages and 12 mini-games from Mr. Brownlow's house to the dark garden at Chertsey.

items.title: Oliver Twist Character Cards
items.description: Collect a card for every character — see their name and what they did in the story so far, then test yourself with Who Am I?

items.title: 5 Seconds Challenge
items.description: Fast-paced game-show style rounds across 7 levels — letters, memory, acting, and brain teasers, all against a 5-second timer.

items.title: Mystery Box Game
items.description: 25 mystery boxes, each hiding a fun icebreaker question or dare — great for getting students talking on day one.

items.title: Mystery Picture
items.description: Reveal a hidden picture tile by tile, use clues, and guess what it is — three difficulty levels plus a teacher mode.

items.title: Might or Could? Detective Game
items.description: 12 detective mysteries to practise might, could and might not for possibilities — with happy background music and a score at the end.

items.title: Passive Voice Quest
items.description: Present simple active → passive, step by step: classify the sentence, flip it, then add be + PP and by. 36 colourful examples across 4 levels.

sections.title: Social Studies
sections.description: Exam revision games for Grade 8 (Flexi curriculum).

items.title: Abbasid Quest
items.description: Seven lessons on the Abbasid era with animated story cards, quizzes, quick-revise flashcards and a final boss fight — a full revision game before the exam.

items.title: Caliphs & Dynasties Arena
items.description: Four mini-games on the caliphs, scholars and dynasties of the Abbasid era — guess who from clues, match names to achievements, order events in time and race the clock. Collect every hero card.
